text:
I checked the proposal and it's clear, so I changed nothing in it.

- **Script:** `node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags.
- **Read:** the title says what is built. There's a numbered build list and a separate list of proofs.
- **Not checked:** I didn't open a rendered page for it.
- **One weakness:** items 4 and 5 in the build list are long, because each packs several rules into one item.

I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I reviewed the say-tools work and the verdict is **fix**: three things must change and seven are worth a look. The full review is in `ask2a-say-tools/review.md`. I made no code edits.

All four test files pass: `say-tools.test.mjs` 11 checks, `Sessions.single.test.mjs` 11, `Sessions.test.mjs` 29 and `Sessions.plugins.test.mjs` 4.

**Must change:**
- **A released `say` isn't written the way `heard()` writes a reply.** If the agent doesn't pass `re`, `release_say` (`Servex/agents/Sessions.js:823`) leaves the reply unlinked to the owner's sentence. `heard()` falls back to `s.smart_re` instead. It also skips `heard()`'s thread placement and its emoji reaction. The brief asked for "exactly as before".
- **Two docs are now stale.** `ux/Dictate/doc/single-voice-assistant.md:13-14` and the header comment at `Sessions.js:75-76` still say the pause-cue turn's text becomes the reply.
- **The worker never reported or landed.** Its log ends with "ended without landing". There are no report lines and no message to the mastermind.

**Worth a look:**
- **Don't merge this before the brief rewrite.** The single seat's brief doesn't tell it to call `say` yet. Until it does, every reply becomes a hidden `skip` line and the owner hears nothing.
- **The gate settings can only be set at boot.** The three gate times come from environment variables. Sessions.js has no per-session setting for them, and neither does the setting the brief pointed to as the pattern.
- **The tool handlers in `tools.js` are never tested.** The check meant to cover `nothing` asserts nothing. I read the code and the agent id does match, but no test proves it.
- **The three tools are visible to every agent**, though they only work for the single seat. A generic `nothing` tool now sits in every mastermind's tool list.
- **Two wording slips.** The `nothing` description says calling it suppresses the skip line, but it doesn't. The docs say "5+ sentences" for the long gate, while the code waits for more than 5.
- **The branch carries about 160 unrelated generated `files.jsonl` changes.** They come from a "wip" commit that exists only on this branch; the real change is 5 files.
- **The new test takes 1.5 s**, against the brief's "under a second".
